evals.name: driver-agnostic-query
evals.prompt: Implement a database-agnostic repository interface in Go using *sql.DB and context.
evals.expected_output: Clean repository implementation depending on standard database/sql interfaces.
assertions: Depends on database/sql standard library interfaces.
Propagates context.Context to QueryContext and ExecContext.
Closes rows via defer rows.Close() and checks rows.Err().

evals.name: null-value-handling
evals.prompt: Handle nullable string and timestamp database columns in Go repository row scanning.
evals.expected_output: Safe scanning using sql.NullString / sql.NullTime or pointer types.
assertions: Uses sql.NullString, sql.NullTime, or *string/*time.Time for nullable columns.
Converts Null types to domain model representation safely.
Avoids runtime panics when scanning NULL database values.

evals.name: transaction-lifecycle-management
evals.prompt: Manage transaction execution ensuring rollback on error and proper commit.
evals.expected_output: Pattern using db.BeginTx, defer tx.Rollback(), and explicit tx.Commit().
assertions: Starts transaction with ctx and txOptions.
Defers tx.Rollback() immediately to guarantee cleanup on panic or early return.
Explicitly commits transaction and returns commit error if failed.
